bullet_points: Load galaxy and halo catalogs for all 10 realizations.
Calculate the empirical 3D radial density profile \rho(r) for satellite galaxies relative to their host halo centers.
Perform a non-parametric Kernel Density Estimation (KDE) of the radial satellite distribution to serve as an empirical null model.

Produce a diagnostic plot showing the empirical radial density profile alongside the theoretical exponential decay P(r) \propto e^{-r/R_{vir}} and the Jacobian-corrected density \rho(r) \propto r^{-2} e^{-r/R_{vir}}, with panels for normalized radial distance r/R_{vir} stacked across all 10 realizations.
Print quantitative goodness-of-fit statistics (chi-squared and KS test p-values) comparing the empirical profile to each theoretical prediction.
Save the computed profiles, KDE model parameters, and diagnostic plots to disk.
sub_tasks.sub_task: Diagnostic Verification and Empirical Null Model Construction

bullet_points: Calculate the full galaxy 2PCF using the Landy-Szalay estimator with a random catalog of at least 5x the galaxy count.
Compute the Void Probability Function (VPF) over sphere radii ranging from 1 to 30 Mpc/h.
Compute the residuals between the empirical 2PCF and the KDE-based synthetic model, expressed as fractional deviations (\Delta\xi / \xi).
Print the fractional residuals numerically per bin to the console.
Save the VPF, 2PCF, and residual metrics to disk.
Compute the marked correlation function M(r) for both satellite-only pairs and all-galaxy pairs in the 1-halo regime (r < 5 Mpc/h) using luminosity as the mark.
Calculate the Spearman rank correlation coefficient and its p-value between the luminosity mark and the local satellite density (using k-th nearest neighbor distance) for each realization.
Print the Spearman coefficients and p-values to the console.
Save the marked correlation results to disk.
Partition halos into mass bins (10^{13} < M < 10^{14} and M > 10^{14} M_\odot/h).
Fit a Generalized NFW (gNFW) profile directly to the empirical satellite radial density profile using the normalized radial coordinate r/R_{vir}.
Report the best-fit inner slope \gamma, scale radius R_s/R_{vir}, and reduced chi-squared for each mass bin.
Print these fit parameters clearly to the console.
Save the fitted gNFW parameters and goodness-of-fit statistics to disk.
Aggregate all metrics (KDE-residual amplitudes, marked correlation coefficients, and mass-binned gNFW fit parameters) across the 10 realizations.
Construct a sample covariance matrix for these metrics.

Generate a single comprehensive multi-panel summary figure (at least 6 subplots) consolidating: mean radial profiles with error bands, VPF comparison, marked correlation function, gNFW fits per mass bin, covariance matrix heatmap, and fractional 2PCF residuals.
Save the summary figure as a high-resolution PNG.
Synthesize findings to assess the catalog's utility and the success of the gNFW-corrected model in recovering the 2PCF at small scales.
Explicitly quantify and report the scale r_{limit} (in Mpc/h) where fractional 2PCF residuals exceed a 10% threshold.
Discuss whether the exponential satellite profile or the gNFW profile better describes the data, referencing the chi-squared values and Spearman coefficients from previous steps.
Write the full Results section of the report, including interpretations of the plots and key statistics.
sub_tasks.sub_task: Model Utility Assessment and Results Reporting
